title: Director, Quality & EHS
text:
**Job Description**
**SCOPE OF POSITION:**
Directs the strategic oversight and continuous improvement of the organization’s manufacturing Quality Management System (QMS) to achieve operational excellence and regulatory compliance.
 
 
**Responsibilities**
**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**
**Requirements**
*To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions, including but not necessarily limited to the following:*

* Develop, maintain and optimize global QMS strategy and processes based on relevant regulatory requirements and aligned with corporate goals.
* Establishes quality governance frameworks, performance metrics, and audit systems to monitor compliance and drive consistent process improvement.
* Partners with senior leadership to integrate quality objectives into overall business planning and customer satisfaction initiatives.
* Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing QMS team. Foster a culture of quality, accountability, and collaboration within the team and across the organization.

**Qualifications**
**KNOWLEDGE/ SKILLS/ EXPERIENCE/ EDUCATION:**
(Minimum Education and/or Experience required)
 
 

* Strong leadership and team-building skills, strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent preferred.
* 6 years in QMS leadership with demonstrated experience leading a quality system.
* Managing and Leading through Influence
* Ability to travel up to 50%

**Competencies**

* Problem Solving
* Process Improvement
* Quality Assurance Process
* Total Quality Management (TQM)
* Strategic Planning
* Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP)
* Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) Processes

**Supervisory Responsibilities**

* yes

**About Us**
CONSTRUCTION SPECIALTIES, INC.
 
 
Founded in 1948, Construction Specialties (CS) is a specialty building products manufacturer. CS provides solutions to building challenges that architects, designers, building owners, facility managers, and contractors face every day. Since inventing the first extruded louver, CS has become a global leader in all our product categories. Our products are a part of some of the most iconic buildings around the world– from the world’s tallest tower, Burj Khalifa in Dubai, to the Oculus at the World Trade Center Transit Hub in Manhattan. If you want to work in an inspiring atmosphere and collaborate with customers and colleagues to solve challenges, we're the right place for you. CS: People. Buildings. Better.
 
 
*Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability/veterans.*
